height.description: The height of the object. Calculated automatically for area shapes, set to 0 when creating an area, defaults to 128

modelId.description: The id of the model object this object represents

width.description: The width of the object. Calculated automatically for area shapes, set to 0 when creating an area, defaults to 256

x.description: The x position of the object. Calculated automatically for area shapes, set to 0 when creating an area

y.description: The y position of the object. Calculated automatically for area shapes, set to 0 when creating an area
